payload.name: Scarcity
payload.fact: Scarcity is a persuasion principle where items or opportunities are perceived as more valuable when they are less available.

provenance.title: Age differences in adaption of persuasion strategies in advertising
provenance.quote_or_locus: offering a stimulus in advertising is most successful when the principles of scarcity, authority, and commitment /consistency are present
